name: Chamomile
description: Daisy-like white flowers with bright yellow centers and finely divided feathery leaves, releasing a sweet, apple-like fragrance.

img.alt: An illustration of seven white chamomile flowers with yellow centres on branching green stems with small attached leaves
img.caption: Small flowers, plenty of character.

grow: Choose a sunny or lightly shaded area in the garden.
Sow seeds thinly in loose, well-drained soil.
Water gently until established, avoiding heavy waterlogging.
Allow plants to self-seed naturally for future seasons.
enjoy: Harvest flower heads to brew a calming cup of tea.
Appreciate the cheerful, daisy-like appearance in casual garden beds.
Dry the blossoms on a tray to store for relaxing infusions.
Let flowers open to invite beneficial hoverflies and bees.
